GenAiPlugin.description: Assign volunteers based on geographic proximity to crisis. This topic is chosen when a request involves finding volunteers near a specific location.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about assigning volunteers based on location, use sfdc_fieldservice__GetAppointmentsToFillGaps.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only assign volunteers based on their geographic proximity to a crisis location. This includes identifying and assigning the nearest available volunteers.
